--- U.S. Coast Guard Heartland District Hurricane Season 2026 --- The 2026 Hurricane Season extends from June 1, 2026 through November 30, 2026.  Tropical storms and hurricanes often develop with little warning.  Extensive damage to small craft often results in loss of life.  All mariners, particularly operators of small fishing vessels, are reminded that advanced planning, which may prevent loss of vessel and crew, should include:  
a) Instruction of crew and passengers in location of emergency equipment and emergency procedures.
b) Pre-sailing check of vessel, machinery, and equipment for seaworthiness.
c) Installation of strong ground tackle.
d) Review of storm center evacuation procedures.
e) Knowledge of the nearest hurricane shelter or port of refuge.

d: Algiers Canal – GIWW – Lock Precautions --- From: 2026-06-23 To: Until Further Notice --- Mariners are to avoid making contact with the canal end long guidewall at Algiers Lock, due to deteriorating timbers and wall instability.  Additionally, Algiers Lock is experiencing surges in the lock chamber due to the low water in the Mississippi River and the Algiers Canal.  Tows are to navigate with extreme caution while entering and exiting the lock and at slow safe speeds to avoid the canal long guidewall area entirely.  If mariners experience a surge, it is recommended that they back out slowly while maintaining control to allow the surge to settle.  For up-to-date information, the Lockmaster at Algiers Lock can be reached at (504) 354-1795 or the Lockwall can be contacted at (504) 354-1861.
